text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper's primary objective is not land use/land cover (LULC) prediction. It uses pre-existing, externally sourced LULC scenario projections from the Great Transition Initiative (GTI) as an input to model and value changes in ecosystem services. The core research question focuses on the valuation of ecosystem services under different scenarios, not on developing, validating, or comparing LULC prediction models. While it implements multiple scenarios and has a national-scale component, it fails the core inclusion criterion that the primary focus must be LULC prediction/simulation.)
